{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{One source|date=June 2026}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |mode=Basketball |year=2016–17 |team=Cal State Northridge Matadors |image=Matadors basketball logo.png |image_size=250 |conference=Big West Conference |division= |short_conf=Big West |CoachRank= |APRank= |record=11–19 |conf_record=7–9 |head_coach=[[Reggie Theus]] |hc_year = 4th |asst_coach1=Jason Levy |asst_coach2=Chris Pompey |asst_coach3=Jeff Theiler |asst_coach4= |stadium=[[Matadome]] |champion= |bowl= |bowl_result= }} {{2016–17 Big West men's basketball standings}} The '''2016–17 Cal State Northridge Matadors men's basketball team''' represented [[California State University, Northridge]] (also known as CSUN) during the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Matadors, led by fourth-year head coach [[Reggie Theus]], played their home games at the [[Matadome]] as members of the [[Big West Conference]]. They finished the season 11–19, 7–9 in Big West play to finish in sixth place. In the [[2017 Big West Conference men's basketball tournament|Big West tournament]], they lost to Cal State Fullerton in the quarterfinals. ==Previous season== The [[2015–16 Cal State Northridge Matadors men's basketball team|Matadors]] finished the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2015–16 season]] 10–20, 5–11 in Big West play to finish in a tie for sixth place. Due to "serious violations" in the basketball program, the school self-imposed a postseason ban.{{Cite web|url=http://www.latimes.com/sports/la-sp-csun-basketball-violation-20160108-story.html|title=CSUN admits violations in men's basketball program, self-imposes postseason ban|last=Times|first=Los Angeles|website=[[Los Angeles Times]]|date=8 January 2016 |access-date=2016-11-16}} ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
